We, the selling stockholders, and the underwriters named below have entered into an underwriting agreement 
 with respect to the shares of Class A common stock being offered. Subject to certain conditions, each 
 underwriter has severally agreed to purchase the number of shares of Class A common stock indicated in the 
 following table. Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC and Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC are the representatives of the 
 underwriters (“representatives”). 
 Underwriters | Number of Shares of Class A Common Stock
 Bookrunners
 Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC | 200,900,000
 Morgan Stanley & Co. LLC | 200,900,000
 J.P. Morgan Securities LLC | 98,000,000
 Citigroup Global Markets Inc. | 98,000,000
 Barclays Capital Inc. and Barclays Bank PLC | 68,600,000
 Wells Fargo Securities, LLC | 68,600,000
 BofA Securities, Inc. | 29,400,000
 Deutsche Bank Securities Inc. | 29,400,000
 RBC Capital Markets, LLC | 29,400,000
 UBS Securities LLC | 29,400,000
 BMO Capital Markets Corp. | 12,740,000
 BNP Paribas Securities Corp. | 12,740,000
 Credit Agricole Securities (USA) Inc. | 12,740,000
 Jefferies LLC | 12,740,000
 Mizuho Securities USA LLC | 19,600,000
 MUFG Securities Americas Inc. | 19,600,000
 TD Securities (USA) LLC | 12,740,000
 Co-managers
 BTIG, LLC | 4,900,000
 Cantor Fitzgerald & Co. | 4,900,000
 Capital One Securities, Inc. | 4,900,000
 Macquarie Capital (USA) Inc. | 4,900,000
 S G Americas Securities, LLC | 4,900,000
 Total | 980,000,000
 The underwriters are committed to take and pay for all of the shares being offered, if any are taken, other than 
 the shares covered by the option described below unless and until this option is exercised. 
 We have granted to the underwriters an option, exercisable for 30 days from the date of this prospectus, to 
 purchase up to an additional 147,000,000 shares of Class A common stock at the initial public offering price set 
 forth on the cover page of this prospectus. The underwriters may exercise this option solely for the purpose of 
 covering over-allotments, if any, made in connection with the offering of the shares of Class A common stock 
 offered by this prospectus. If any shares are purchased pursuant to this option, the underwriters will severally 
 purchase shares in approximately the same proportion as set forth in the table above. The underwriters do not 
 expect sales to discretionary accounts to exceed five percent of the total number of shares of Class A common 
 stock offered.
